heading: Grievous hurt caused whilst committing lurking house-trespass or house-breaking.
text: Whoever, whilst committing lurking house-trespass or house-breaking, causes grievous hurt to any person or attempts to cause death or grievous hurt to any person, shall be punished with [1][imprisonment for life], or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by Act 26 of 1955, s. 117 and the Sch., for “transportation for life” (w.e.f. 1-1-1956).
